data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'basharah' which means 'good news'. In the Quran, the name Bishr is given to a man who brought good news to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). It signifies clear vision and understanding. The name Bishry carries the meaning “Bright, Clear” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bishry usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with hope and positivity, symbolizing the light of knowledge and understanding.
data.etymology: Bishry belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, Clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bishry total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
